name: Circle of Fauna (Druid Circle)
body:
You draw power from the living creatures and animals of the world.

Bonus Spells: calm animals (1st), hold animal (2nd), dominate animal (3rd), baleful polymorph (4th), animal growth (5th), antilife shell (6th), magical beast shape (7th), animal shapes (8th). shapechange (9th).

Manifestation: You have a smell of a wild animal, abundant or wild hair, and/or skin that looks like scales. Your eyes look like those of an animal of your choice in color and shape. This has no effect on your vision.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Animal Connection (Sp)

At 1st level, the legendary druid can cast detect animals and plants at-will, but only to detect animals.

At 8th level, the emanation works in all directions and also detects magical beasts. At 16th level, the range increases to 1 mile per class level.

As part of this spell, the legendary druid can telepathically connect with any creature they detect.

Bestial-infused Magic (Su)

At 8th level, anytime you cast a spell on yourself or on a creature you can sense with the animal connection ability, you can increase the spell slot level used by 1 to deliver a “bestial” spell along with the original spell. A “bestial” spell is any spell with “animal” or an animal type in the name, such as bear’s endurance, or any spell that specifically targets animals. The “bestial” spell delivered must be at least 2 levels lower than the original spell. The “bestial” spell retains its normal statistics.

Fauna Sensing (Su)

At 16th level, by focusing your will as a full-round action, you can experience the senses of any creature within 1 mile per level of your location. You must be aware of the creature (such as through your Animal Connection ability), but do not need to know their exact location. This does not subvert the creature’s senses or allow you to control them, however you can use any divination spell (like detect magic) through this sensory input. This is not a scrying effect and as such is not in itself subject to the nondetection or detect scrying spells. You can maintain this connection for as long as you wish, however, the senses of your original body are dulled and you take a -10 penalty on any Perception checks made to sense things around you. Perception checks made through the creature’s senses are unaffected.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Aura of Animal Freedom (Su)

(Minor Talent)

Animals and magical beasts cannot be compelled, magically or otherwise, to attack you, unless you harm it. If an animal is magically compelled via a dominate animal or similar spell effect, they get an immediate saving throw to end the domination with a +4 circumstance bonus.

Fauna Projection (Su)

(Major Talent)

You may use any animal or magical beast within 30 feet as the origination of your legendary druid spells. For example, you may have the daylight spell originate from an object the creature is touching or the creature itself.

Share Spells (Su)

(Minor Talent)

You may cast any spell with a range of self on any animal or magical beast within 30 feet.
